name: flywheel-relay
description: The relay Worker paired phones reach a Flywheel runtime through, and the phone host that mounts the web client against it.

scripts.deploy:worker: bun run probe.ts --before-deploy && bunx wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:app: bun run app/build.ts && bunx wrangler deploy --config app/wrangler.jsonc
